colombia-scope-probe.17220dc598: Ghana, speaking for three African Council members, welcomed the unanimous mandate extension, supported Mission monitoring contingent on the Secretary-General's conditions, and pledged to encourage progress on the Ethnic Chapter for Afro-Colombian and Indigenous people [A3].
colombia-scope-probe.6892a23e1f:
[ADDITIONAL] Resolution 2704 expressed willingness to consider Government–EMC monitoring only after the Secretary-General confirms a ceasefire with appropriate protocols, distinct from Resolution 2694's existing authority for the ELN.

[BRAZIL] The presiding representative, speaking for Brazil, supported Colombia's sovereign will and urged Council authorization of EMC verification solely when the situation is sufficiently mature.

[A3] Ghana, representing the three African members, supported prospective EMC monitoring contingent on the Secretary-General's conditions while pledging to encourage progress on the Ethnic Chapter.

All three entities support a possible conditional future role for EMC monitoring, unified by the prerequisite of Secretary-General confirmation and appropriate verification protocols.
